name: Park Hyatt Jakarta
short_description: Indonesia's first Park Hyatt, occupying the top 17 floors of Park Tower with a 35th-floor rooftop pool and views of the National Monument.
ai_summary: Park Hyatt Jakarta, Indonesia's first Park Hyatt, opened in July 2022 occupying the top 17 floors of the 37-storey Park Tower, with rooms from the 29th floor up offering views of the golden-flamed National Monument and the capital's skyline. Guests consistently praise the anticipatory, personalized service, modern stylish design, and a well-regarded spa, along with a rooftop pool on the 35th floor. As one of the newer luxury hotels in the city, it commands a real price premium over Jakarta's more established Hyatt properties, though reviewers widely consider it worth it for the views and service level.

core_facts.address: Jl. Kebon Sirih No.17-19, Menteng, Central Jakarta 10340, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Complimentary full breakfast daily for World of Hyatt Globalist Elite members at properties without a dedicated club lounge, per World of Hyatt program terms
Room upgrades for Explorist and Globalist Elite members, subject to availability
Late check-out until 4pm for Globalist Elite members, subject to availability

pros: Indonesia's first Park Hyatt, occupying the top 17 floors of the 37-storey Park Tower
Rooms from the 29th floor up have views of the National Monument and Jakarta's skyline
Staff are repeatedly described as eager to anticipate guests' wishes
Deep-soaking marble baths with Le Labo products and a well-regarded spa
cons: Commands a real price premium over Jakarta's more established Hyatt properties
As one of the newer luxury hotels in the city, it doesn't yet have the long track record of Jakarta's older 5-star hotels
research_highlights: Guests describe staff as eager to anticipate their wishes throughout the stay
The modern, stylish design and spa draw consistently strong praise
Views of the National Monument and skyline are called impressive from the higher floors
research_watchouts: Room rates run notably higher than Jakarta's more established Hyatt properties

faqs.question: When did Park Hyatt Jakarta open?
faqs.answer: It opened in July 2022 as Indonesia's first Park Hyatt, occupying the top 17 floors of the 37-storey Park Tower in Menteng, Central Jakarta -- making it one of the newer luxury hotels in the city compared with Jakarta's more established 5-star properties.

faqs.question: Does Park Hyatt Jakarta have views of the National Monument?
faqs.answer: Yes -- rooms from the 29th floor and up offer views of the golden-flamed National Monument (Monas) and Jakarta's skyline, a distinguishing feature given the hotel's height within Park Tower.

reviews.title: Park Hyatt Jakarta review: Experience Indonesia's dynamic capital from on high
reviews.summary: Describes Indonesia's first Park Hyatt occupying the top 17 floors of a 37-storey tower, with impressive Monas and skyline views from a 29th-floor room, multiple dining venues, and rooms starting around $703 per night.
